source.idNamespace: SkyGame-Data nanoid GUIDs; independent of Caelus IDs and official game IDs

warnings: Fan-maintained snapshot; metadata is not live game state and not proof of present accessibility.
Each listed light/shrine has a stable source GUID. Missing metadata remains null.
All 125 lights have a textual description; only 18 of 69 shrines have one. 51 shrine positions are known only to area level in this text-only export.
Descriptions are original English source text. Chinese realm/area labels use exact-name matches to the separately licensed Caelus locale.
Source map/video/image asset URLs are omitted and no artwork has been downloaded.
The source mapData positions are coordinates of the source planner map, not in-game coordinates; they are deliberately excluded.
Candle schema is marked unstable upstream. rawCandleCount preserves c literally; no guaranteed candle income or travel time is inferred.
Area connections are graph metadata only. Do not claim the shortest/time-tested route or ignore gate conditions.
Do not merge these GUIDs with Caelus numeric IDs. Area counts may disagree because the snapshots classify areas differently.
